brief.use: in-match background loop (under the play, not over it)
brief.game: Fuzeball: 3D table football for an intergalactic Federation; blue + Federation gold
brief.references: pulsing synth ostinato, big reverb and dotted delay throws, taiko and brass swells, cinematic space sport
brief.notes: Bb minor (tritone of E major: shares only A and D#/Eb with it, so it contrasts the E menu tracks without fighting them). 32-bar loop: A(8) B(8) C(8) A'(8). Quiet bed: target -20 LUFS, sits under the rods and crowd. Humanized, not hard-quantized.
